reviews.text: Accent Pools was absolutely fantastic to work with, and we could not be happier with our Pool. From the start with working with Tom, he was amazing to help us through the process and all the months while building our home and helping us design our pool. To Mike, & David and all the crew during the building process. Even after all complete, Oscar and our cleaning guy Tanner with Accent is always on top of things and communication is absolutely fantastic.  If you are looking for a Pool build look no further! Accent Pools is definitely the best, and they are dedicated to making your outdoor backyard dreams come true! We recommend to anyone looking to building a pool!
reviews.author: Deanna Zaudke

reviews.text: We absolutely love our pool and are so happy and satisfied that we chose Accent Pools! It has been one year now since our pool was built and I just want to say that Accent Pools is by far the best pool company! They started construction on our 30x15 heated pool on January 9 and they performed our pool start-up on March 9, about 8 weeks later! Accent Pools was at our house only 16 times for one reason or another during that 2 months, the rest of the time was for waiting on things to dry, be inspected, etc. Please understand you may not have a similar fast experience, but I just wanted to point out how efficient they were with our pool build. Tom was very attentive with the details of our pool design as well as the deck they installed too. Meghan was very efficient and timely with communication of what was going to be happening and when. We still use Accent Pools til this day for our weekly pool maintenance. If you’re in the market for a pool construction company, this is your sign to look no further!
reviews.author: Kessler Park

reviews.text:
After some pretty uneducated and scary experiences looking for a company to do a pool renovation, I lucked out when my next door neighbor recommended Accent Pools. Our sales person, Abel, was amazing and did an excellent job coordinating the project from start to finish. Abel was an excellent communicator and very knowledgeable regarding the pool renovation business. Kim in the office was very helpful and knowledgeable as well, walking me through the payment process and answering questions along the way.
I will recommend Accent Pools in the future.
reviews.author: Evelyn Ellis

reviews.text:
We are so happy that we went with Accent Pools to build our pool! The communication was great throughout every step of the entire build process. Tom even went above and beyond to guarantee that Accent Pools would deliver exactly what we wanted!

We highly recommend Accent Pools!
reviews.author: Nathan Levenson

reviews.text: Ethan is fantastic at what he does. He listens to customers, cares about helping them, and always puts their best interests first. He does a thorough job keeping the pool clean and even shows care for any animals he meets during his visits. Hardworking, reliable, very knowledgeable and thoughtful. He truly deserves a raise.
reviews.author: Kennedy Berube

reviews.text: Accent Pools did a phenomenal job with our pool, covered patio and custom Steelers logo. I highly recommend Accent.
reviews.author: Jamal Dixon

reviews.text: We were very diligent in our research when we finally decided to have the pool installed.  We got bids and plans from 4 different companies and finally decided on Accent.  Tom was professional and kept up with our questions and he was the only one who actually listened to what we wanted, changed the plans a few times and we finally decided on our most major investment since our house.  We started in the fall when the weather was not our friend, if you remember it rain a lot!  Mike was amazing, just plain amazing!  He was very patient with this very nervous homeowner, kept me up to date on delays(the delays were not their fault, it was all weather related), everyone showed up on the scheduled times, were friendly, answered all my questions, and did an absolutely fabulous job.  Mike's favorite expression with me was "stay calm, we got this, it will be great" and he was 110% right.  I highly recommend this company, from Tom to Mike to Sarah and the entire family(that is how I think of them now) you will not be disappointed and you will be as happy as we are :)
reviews.author: Veronica E Ireland

reviews.text:
I was searching for a different pool service provider and decided to give the company that installed my pool a try. Accent Pools has exceeded my expectations! The customer service, effective communication through emails, excellent technicians, and affordable rates has made my experience exceptional!

Noe and his team rocks! If you are looking for a reliable company with budget friendly rates, great technicians, and  excellent customer service, you found them!
reviews.author: Nikki Marshall

data.summary: The Google reviews appear authentic and detailed, but the strategic sample is skewed, showing only positive reviews. The company has a long history (48 years) and an A+ BBB rating. The significant discrepancy with Yelp's 3.3 rating is a concern, indicating potential issues not visible in the provided Google data. The positive reviews contain strong authentic signals like specific names and project details.
fake_signals: Strategic sample shows only 5-star reviews, no negative or mixed feedback
Some reviews are generic (e.g., 'phenomenal job') with minimal detail

positive_evidence: Tom went above and beyond to guarantee that Accent Pools would deliver exactly what we wanted

authentic_signals: Specific employee names (Tom, Mike, David, Oscar, Tanner, Abel, Kim, Ethan, Noe)
Detailed project timelines and descriptions (e.g., 30x15 heated pool, 8-week build)
Varied writing styles and specific customer situations (new build, renovation, service)
Mentions of weather delays and coordination with home building
complaint_patterns: Potential communication or service issues (inferred from Yelp rating)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Significant rating gap between Google (4.4) and Yelp (3.3). Google reviews are uniformly positive (sampled 8 five-star), while Yelp's lower score suggests a mix of experiences not captured in the Google sample.
